verdict.rationale: A community report says Increase's own terms page names the charter holders (First Internet Bank or Blue Ridge Bank), with Increase as the API layer on top. Commenters confirm Increase is not itself a bank, comparing it to Column, Bond, Unit and Synapse. First-party docs only mention FDIC-insured sweeps via IntraFi network banks and never explain the sponsor model or customer outcomes if Increase fails. Missing for 10: first-party docs naming the partner bank(s) and describing the program structure, a documented failure/wind-down plan covering customer fund protection, FDIC pass-through and ledger/recordkeeping, and independent corroboration.
